line_items.description: Helsinki Airport Departure Tax & Security Fee

reasoning: Round-trip economy flight FRA-HEL for the Nordic Tech Summit and onsite partner onboarding, per the submission note. Advance booking (Ch.4): ticket issued 2024-04-12, first segment departs 2024-05-02, i.e. 20 days ahead. Only bookings made fewer than 7 calendar days before departure are rejected without a stated reason; 20 days clears that hard window, so the 21-day international advance-booking guidance (a best-practice card, not an enforced rejection trigger) does not cost anything. Cabin class (Ch.4): both segments are economy, which is mandatory for segments under 8 hours; both FRA-HEL legs are roughly 3.5h and 2.5h, so no premium-cabin violation. Taxes and surcharges (Ch.4): the four fee lines are government passenger service and security taxes, an airport departure tax, and the carrier-imposed YQ fuel surcharge, all of which are part of the ticket price and fully reimbursable; there are no seat-selection, priority, lounge, Wi-Fi, or checked-bag fees to deduct. Weekend rule (Ch.9/Ch.13 Figure 1): the receipt is dated Friday 2024-04-12, and flight tickets are not weekend expenses merely because travel days fall on a weekend, so the flowchart does not apply. Note requirements (Ch.2/Ch.3): the note states the trip purpose and names the Practice Leader who pre-approved the international booking, satisfying the written pre-approval requirement. Nothing is deducted, so the line is approved in full: 540.00 + 78.50 + 42.10 + 38.20 + 96.00 = 794.80 EUR, fully reimbursed.
